test_inputs.label: ЦРЦТ demo meeting transcript (51 min, Russian)

assertions.description: Report is written in Russian (matches transcript language)
assertions.source_rule: Write in the language of the transcript — Russian transcript = Russian report, English = English

assertions.description: JTBD section uses the required format: 'Когда... я хочу... чтобы...'
assertions.source_rule: Convert → JTBD: 'Когда [ситуация], я хочу [мотивация], чтобы [результат]' — Functional / Emotional / Social

assertions.description: Pains are categorized as явная or вероятная (explicit vs probable)
assertions.source_rule: Extract raw signals: Pains (явная/вероятная), feature requests, objections, buying triggers...

assertions.description: Contains verbatim customer quotes with speaker attribution
assertions.source_rule: Quote verbatim — use exact customer words, with speaker and timestamp
Map decision dynamics: Champion / Blocker / Neutral / User for each participant
Score opportunity: X/12 viability (see report-template.md §10 for criteria)

assertions.description: Competitive context mentions at least one competitor from the transcript
assertions.source_rule: Map competitive context: For each competitor: why mentioned, strengths, gaps, who brought it up

assertions.description: Next steps are specific (not generic) — have priority marker AND deadline/owner
assertions.source_rule: Each must have: priority, action, effort estimate, owner, target date. No generic advice — specific to THIS customer

assertions.description: Report contains the misalignment/разрывы section with actual misalignment entries
assertions.source_rule: Often the most valuable finding. Common patterns: Customer uses a term → our team interprets differently → demo goes off-track

assertions.description: Emotional timeline/energy map references specific time sections
assertions.source_rule: Build emotional timeline: Energy spikes (what sells) and drops (what blocks)

assertions.description: Pain mentions are linked to JTBD jobs (not standalone)
assertions.source_rule: JTBD is the PRIMARY section. Pains are secondary — short list, linked to jobs. Don't duplicate content across sections

assertions.description: Output does NOT contain the phrase 'generic advice'
assertions.source_rule: No generic advice — next steps must be specific to THIS customer

assertions.description: Ambiguous claims are marked with [AMBIGUOUS] or [INFERRED] markers
assertions.source_rule: Don't guess — mark ambiguity as [AMBIGUOUS] with your best interpretation. Distinguish observed vs. inferred

assertions.description: Customer profile section covers organization, stack, and environment
assertions.source_rule: Report template §1: Профиль клиента — организация, отрасль, масштаб, текущий стек, среда

assertions.description: Interest triggers section references specific timestamps from the transcript
assertions.source_rule: Quick Reference Step 6: Map interest triggers with timestamps, what was shown, reaction type

assertions.description: Report distinguishes observed facts from inferred conclusions
assertions.source_rule: Distinguish observed vs. inferred — 'Client said X' vs. 'Client likely feels Y because...'
